designer_disclosure: The designer knows the #2341 result because the user stated it in the task. No rule below references #2341 numbers. Every data-driven quantity is computed by code that can only read history ending at #2340 (results/lotto/draw2341/draws.json, asserted last draw_id == 2340).

data.design_dataset: results/lotto/draw2341/draws.json (2161-2340, 180 draws); the code asserts the last draw is 2340 and that #2341 is absent
data.features: unchanged V1 functions from scripts/analyze.py (model_features, objectives, structure, ensemble_weights, sample, indicator)
data.walk_forward: V1 origins: every target index >= 50 (V1 minimum training); P0 targets need >= 20 prior V1 origins, so the first P0 target is index 70

families.A_long: V1 z-scored smoothed full frequency (model_features scores[0])
families.E_pairs: scores[4]; informative at an origin only if std > 1e-12 (i.e. at least one Holm-retained pair)
families.F_structure: NO marginal number representation exists in V1 (it is a whole-ticket objective). Number-level weight fixed at 0; it enters only in Stage B, and only if validated.
families.G_ensemble: derived linear combination of A-E (V1 G marginal proxy = ew[:5] @ scores). Reported, but number-level weight fixed at 0 to avoid double counting.

stage_A_discovery.per_origin_evidence: x_f,u = (mean over the 6 winners at origin u of pct_f) - 0.5, where pct = (38 - midrank)/37 and midrank averages tied positions (a flat ranking gives exactly 0). Only origins where f is informative are counted.
stage_A_discovery.null_sd_per_origin: sigma = sqrt( ((38^2-1)/12)/37^2 / 6 * (32/37) ) = 0.11253 (exact, 6 of 38 without replacement, continuous ranks)
stage_A_discovery.standardized_evidence: dbar_f = mean_u(x_f,u) / sigma over the n_f prior informative origins
stage_A_discovery.shrinkage: d_f = dbar_f * n_f*tau^2 / (n_f*tau^2 + 1), tau = 0.09 (prior SD of the true standardized per-draw effect; roughly one percentile point of winner rank). Posterior mean under a N(0, tau^2) prior, i.e. shrink toward zero predictive contribution.
stage_A_discovery.stability_factor: h_f = 1 if the mean of x_f over both chronological halves of the prior origins is > 0; 0.5 if exactly one half > 0; 0 if neither
stage_A_discovery.weight: w_f = max(0, d_f) * h_f  (0 if n_f < 20, and 0 for F, G, H at number level)
stage_A_discovery.marginal_score: M_i = sum_f w_f * z_f,i  (z = V1 z-scored family score at the origin; flat families contribute 0)
stage_A_discovery.ordering: primary key M_i (descending); ties (including the all-zero case) broken by EQ_i = mean of z_f,i over the informative A-E families (declared NON-EVIDENTIAL ordering convention); then by number ascending
stage_A_discovery.frozen_weights_for_prospective_use: For #2341 (shadow) and #2342 the weights are the formula's output at cutoff #2340 and are frozen as constants. #2341 is NOT used to update weights. Family z-scores (features) for #2342 do use history through #2341 as ordinary data.

discovery_pool_size.evaluation_period: P0 development targets only (P0 targets before the V1 confirmation boundary, i.e. draw_id < 2301)
discovery_pool_size.statistic: c_K,t = winners inside the top-K of the P0 ordering; null c ~ Hypergeometric(38 balls, 6 winners, K drawn); expected 6K/38
discovery_pool_size.test_per_K: exact one-sided p of sum_t c_K,t by convolution of the per-origin hypergeometric pmf; Holm across the 4 options; circular 5-block bootstrap (10,000 reps, seed 20260930) 95% lower bound of mean excess; mean excess in both chronological halves of the development period
discovery_pool_size.pass_K: Holm p < 0.05 AND bootstrap lower bound > 0 AND both halves > 0
discovery_pool_size.selection: if any K passes: the passing K with the largest standardized excess z_K = (mean c - 6K/38) / (sd_K / sqrt(n)). Otherwise the predeclared default.
discovery_pool_size.default_rationale: Middle option; 5,005 combinations; two challenger tickets (12 numbers) can cover most of the pool; neither the most concentrated reliance on an unvalidated ranking (10/12) nor the most diffuse (20). Chosen before any data. Labelled NO EDGE when used.
discovery_pool_size.reported_not_used_for_selection: confirmation-period capture, >=3/>=4/>=5/6 capture probabilities, variance, downstream portfolio performance for every K

stage_B_ticket_universe: all C(K,6) combinations of the top-K pool, enumerated exhaustively (no sampling)

stage_B_ticket_score.definition: T(t) = sum_{f in A..E} w_f * Z[ mean_{i in t} z_f,i ] + w_pair * Z[ pair(t) ] + w_struct * Z[ structure(t) ]
stage_B_ticket_score.Z: standardize across all enumerated combinations in the pool at that origin (0 if constant)
stage_B_ticket_score.pair(t): V1 E_pairs ticket objective: sum of Holm-retained pair lifts inside t / 30 (V1 objectives row 4)
stage_B_ticket_score.structure(t): V1 F_structure ticket objective: minus mean squared standardized structure distance (V1 objectives row 5)
stage_B_ticket_score.w_pair: max(0, d_pairT) * h_pairT, from V1 walk-forward E_pairs ticket matches: per-origin standardized excess (m - 36/38) / 0.83065, only origins with >= 1 retained pair, same tau=0.09 shrinkage, same stability factor, same minimum 20
stage_B_ticket_score.w_struct: max(0, d_F) * h_F, from V1 walk-forward F_structure ticket matches, same formula
stage_B_ticket_score.forbidden: no spacing, consecutive, parity, high/low, sum, recent-repeat, overdue or anti-repeat rule unless it is the V1 F_structure objective and passes the evidence shrinkage above; no reference to any specific draw's numbers
stage_B_ticket_score.tie_breaks: EQ(t) = mean over the ticket of EQ_i (non-evidential), then lexicographic numbers

portfolio.ticket_1: the frozen V1 Science ticket (may contain numbers outside the pool)
portfolio.tickets_2_3: chosen greedily from the pool universe, ticket 2 first, then ticket 3
portfolio.supported_mass: m_i = max(0.01, 1 + M_i) normalized over the pool numbers (weak evidence gives almost uniform mass)
portfolio.incremental_coverage: Cov(t|S) = sum of m_i over numbers of t not already in any selected ticket, divided by 6/K
portfolio.overlap_rule: hard: |t intersect s| <= 2 for every already selected s (including ticket 1). If no pool combination satisfies it, relax to <= 3, then <= 4.
portfolio.evidence_exception: the overlap rule is waived only if sum of all weights > 0 AND the best unconstrained T exceeds the best feasible T by more than 2 SD of T over the pool; then the best unconstrained J is taken. Recorded if used.
portfolio.recorded: raw T, J, Cov, overlaps, unique numbers covered, family contributions

historical_test.targets: every P0 target index 70..end of design dataset (draws 2231-2340)
historical_test.confirmation: targets 2301-2340 (40 targets; the same as the V1 confirmation window)
historical_test.ticket_1_history: V1-style reconstruction: the V1 candidate generator at each cutoff (validated against the frozen #2339/#2340/#2341 pools), the V1 evidence gate, and the V1 seeded fallback (seed 20260919) with the <=2-overlap rule chained on the reconstructed previous primary. Where the gate would have passed, V1 needed Jev, so the origin is flagged and the fallback ticket is used.

comparators.B: 3 uniform random tickets with pairwise overlap <= 2 (rejection sampling)
comparators.C: V1 ticket + 2 uniform random tickets, overlap <= 2 with the V1 ticket and each other
comparators.D: 3 highest standalone T tickets in the pool (no portfolio optimization, no overlap rule)

historical_test.metrics: best-ticket matches, total portfolio matches, challengers-only total (tickets 2+3), >=3 / >=4 / >=5 / 6 events (any ticket), unique numbers covered, mean pairwise overlap
historical_test.null_model: draws uniform: for each fixed portfolio, the per-origin null pmf of each statistic is estimated from 20,000 uniform draws (seed 20260932 + draw_id); sums over origins use convolution

endpoints: E1 challengers-only total matches (tickets 2+3) vs null
E2 portfolio best-ticket matches vs null
E3 count of origins with a >=3 ticket vs null
gate.PASS: E1 Holm p < 0.05 AND bootstrap 95% lower bound of the E1 mean excess > 0 AND E1 mean excess > 0 in both halves of the confirmation period
gate.otherwise: FAIL: the portfolio is a coverage experiment, not a demonstrated predictive edge

prospective_use.shadow_2341: after the protocol freeze commit: the frozen P0 applied to the pre-draw #2341 state (cutoff #2340) with the frozen #2341 V1 ticket as ticket 1; descriptive only, no retuning
prospective_use.draw_2342: after appending #2341 as one ordinary observation: features at cutoff #2341, frozen weights and K, all pool combinations enumerated, tickets 2-3 selected around the frozen #2342 V1 ticket

jev_role: Jev does not choose P0 tickets. After the 3-ticket portfolio is frozen, one separate Jev audit call (jev-latest) with Scores and Nouls on robustness, overfitting/chance, dependence on weak evidence, model-family concentration and fragility. The audit cannot change any ticket. Its outputs are evidence judgments, not winning probabilities.
random_control_2342: 3 uniform random tickets with pairwise overlap <= 2, rejection sampling with seed 20260930, research only
